Name: Rofaxan 2089 AD
Overview:
This is a 2D Retro shooter coupled with "Thunder and Lightning's" amazing album "In Charge of the Scythe." These pulse pounding metal with the blaster and bullets flying everywhere make this a fun shooter that throws back to the day when games prized fun over everything else.

This single player 2D Shooter is of the horizontal variety coupling parallax scrolling on many layers, huge bosses and even a hidden stage! This game is truly the shrine to the PC Engine, Sega Genesis and SNES style shooters of the early and mid 90's. Similar to games such as R-Type but with a sound track like that of Lords or Gates of Thunder this is one hell of a trip that must be tried by any fan of the SHMUPS!
